lines.en: label karinsoccer20:
scene karinadventure1
: I’m gonna dieeeeeeeeeeeeeee...
lines.zh: : 我要死了啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: Hi there.
lines.zh: 嗨，你好啊。

lines.en: As much as I’d love to tell you that the reason these two girls are beet red and dripping sweat is sexual, it isn’t.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想告诉你们，这两个女孩满脸通红、大汗淋漓的原因是性，但并不是。

lines.en: The reason for this is actually much simpler and...well, involves exactly what this gym is made for and why this team exists in the first place.
lines.zh: 真正的原因其实简单得多……嗯，说白了就是这间体育馆本来是拿来干什么的，以及这支队伍为什么会存在。

lines.en: The thing is, I’ve seen them practice a million times by now and have never seen them {i}this{/i} exhausted.
lines.zh: 问题是，她们训练我到现在也看过无数次了，却从没见过她们累成{i}这样{/i}。

lines.en: So...what was so different about today, you ask?
lines.zh: 那么……你肯定要问，今天到底有什么不一样？

lines.en: scene karinadventure2
: Did ya really have to be so ruthless today?
lines.zh: : 你今天非得这么狠吗？

lines.en: : Is givin’ ya free reign of the practice schedule goin’ to your head? This some sort of power trip?
lines.zh: : 把训练计划全权交给你，是不是让你飘了？这是在过权力瘾吗？

lines.en: : No...I just...read in a magazine that intense workouts can be good if done in moderation.
lines.zh: : 不是……我只是……在一本杂志上看到，高强度训练只要适度，对身体是有好处的。

lines.en: : And we’ve never really gone at it that hard and long before.
lines.zh: : 而且我们以前从来没有练得这么狠、这么久过。

lines.en: : Ha.
scene karinadventure3
: Hm? Why are you laughing?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你笑什么？

lines.en: : What you just said.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说的那句话。

lines.en: : That we went at it hard and long?
lines.zh: : 说我们练得又狠又久？

lines.en: : Is this some sort of inside joke?
lines.zh: : 这是什么内部笑话吗？

lines.en: : Nah. Sensei’s just bein’ bad with girls again.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是 Sensei 又在女孩子面前犯坏了。

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: : That aside, you guys should be done for the day now, right?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你们今天应该练完了吧？

lines.en: scene karinadventure4
: Right!
: Like I said, it’s only good to do things like this in moderation. Overworking yourself on a daily basis is one of the easiest ways to destroy your body.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，这种事只有适度才好。每天把自己练到透支，是毁掉身体最简单的方式之一。

lines.en: : Well that’s great for me because it means I get to actually talk to you two instead of just staring at you for a concerning amount of time.
lines.zh: : 那对我来说可太好了，因为这样我就真的能跟你们两个说上话，而不是盯着你们看上一段令人担忧的时间。

lines.en: scene karinadventure5
: Um...please don’t stare for too long...
lines.zh: : 嗯……请不要盯太久……

lines.en: : It’ll make me...trip or something...
lines.zh: : 我会……绊倒什么的……

lines.en: : There somethin’ you were lookin’ to do, Sensei? Or were ya literally just gonna talk to us?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你是有什么想做的事吗？还是说你真的就只是想跟我们聊聊天？

lines.en: : Is there something wrong with “literally just talking to you?”
lines.zh: : “真的只是聊聊天”有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s boring.
lines.zh: : 有。太无聊了。

lines.en: scene karinadventure6
: I wanna go on an adventure!
lines.zh: : 我想去冒险！

lines.en: : An adventure?
lines.zh: : 冒险？

lines.en: : Yeah! No practice regime is too tough for Miku Maruyama!
lines.zh: : 对啊！对 Miku Maruyama 来说，就没有什么训练计划算太狠的！

lines.en: : And now that her blood’s pumpin’, she’s ready to take on the world!
lines.zh: : 而且现在她血液沸腾，已经准备好去征服世界了！

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say you wanted to die?
lines.zh: : 你刚才不是说你想死吗？

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 没有！

lines.en: : Sensei! How do you feel about an adventure?
lines.zh: : Sensei！你觉得去冒险怎么样？

lines.en: : Bad.
lines.zh: : 不怎么样。

lines.en: : Well tough cookies because you’re outvoted two to one!
lines.zh: : 那也没办法，因为你被二比一票数压制了！

lines.en: scene karinadventure7
: Oh, okay. I guess I choose the adventure option instead of taking a shower like I really wanted to.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。看来我选了冒险这个选项，而不是我真正想做的洗个澡。

lines.en: : We can shower later!
lines.zh: : 我们可以晚点再洗！

lines.en: : I hate gettin’ in there next to you anyway, Karin.
lines.zh: : 反正我也不喜欢挨着你进去洗，Karin。

lines.en: : I learned recently that what I lack in the chest department, I make up for in abs- and you’ve got me beat in both of those things.
lines.zh: : 我最近才知道，我胸部上缺的，靠腹肌补回来了——可你这两样都赢我。

lines.en: : Yes, Miku. You remind me of that after every practice.
lines.zh: : 是的，Miku。你每次训练后都要提醒我一遍。

lines.en: : Karin, if you’re not feeling up to it, I’m sure that the two of us could overpower-
lines.zh: : Karin，如果你不太想的话，我相信我们两个可以合力把你——

lines.en: scene karinadventure8
: I’m fine with an adventure...I’m just not very good at coming up with ideas, so it will probably be really boring and you’ll probably hate it.
lines.zh: : 我愿意去冒险……只是我不太擅长想点子，所以大概会很无聊，你们大概也会讨厌。

lines.en: : Anywhere is fine as long as I can be with you.
lines.zh: : 只要能和你在一起，去哪儿都行。

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
scene karinadventure9
: Wha-?!
: Wh-wh-wh-wh-what are you saying?! That makes it sound like you and me are...
lines.zh: : 你你你你你在说什么啊？！这话听起来好像你和我……

lines.en: : Ooooh, direct hit. Nice job, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，直击要害。干得漂亮，Sensei。

lines.en: : Are what, Karin?
lines.zh: : 是什么，Karin？

lines.en: scene karinadventure10
: I...I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道！

lines.en: : Ask someone else!
lines.zh: : 你去问别人！

lines.en: else:
scene karinadventure11
: Are you...sure you’re not confusing me with my sister?
lines.zh: : 你……该不会是把我跟我的妹妹搞混了吧？

lines.en: : Hm? Kirin’s not even here today.
lines.zh: : 嗯？Kirin 今天根本没来。

lines.en: Well, it looks like it’s still a little too early to make jokes like that after coming clean about my...{i}relationship{/i} with Kirin.
lines.zh: 看来，在我坦白了和 Kirin 的……{i}关系{/i}之后，现在开这种玩笑还是有点太早了。

lines.en: scene karinadventure12
: Alls I know is...if we’re gonna do this thing, we better get goin’ soon!
lines.zh: : 我只知道……既然要做这件事，我们最好赶紧出发！

lines.en: : And since it was {i}my{/i} idea to go on this adventure in the first place, I leave choosin’ the adventure up to you two.
lines.zh: : 而且这个冒险本来就是{i}我的{/i}主意，所以去哪儿冒险就交给你们两个决定。

lines.en: : I hereby relinquish all responsibility onto Karin as I didn’t even want to do this in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我在此把所有责任全权移交给 Karin，因为从一开始我就不想干这个。

lines.en: : I am more than happy with staying here and making more suggestive jokes that Karin doesn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我更乐意待在这儿，继续讲那些 Karin 听不懂的黄色笑话。

lines.en: : It’s...not really much of an {i}adventure,{/i} but...I kind of needed to go get something from my classroom...
lines.zh: : 这……算不上什么{i}冒险{/i}，不过……我正好要去教室拿点东西……

lines.en: : Would...that work?
lines.zh: : 那样……可以吗？

lines.en: scene karinadventure13
: Heck yeah it would! And it’s close enough that Sensei probably won’t even complain about it!
lines.zh: : 当然可以！而且够近，Sensei 大概连抱怨都不会抱怨！

lines.en: : Well...it {i}is{/i} in this building...
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正{i}就在{/i}这栋楼里……

lines.en: : So yeah. I guess that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 所以行吧。我觉得没问题。

lines.en: scene karinadventure14
: Heck yeah! Adventure crew away! First person to make it to Karin’s classroom is crowned the queen or king of...adventuring or something!
lines.zh: : 太好了！冒险小队出发！第一个跑到 Karin 教室的人，就会被加冕为……冒险之王还是什么的！

lines.en: : Um...yaaaaay?
scene black

Karin and Miku get off the ground, grabbing their bags and dropping them off in the girls’ locker room before coming back out and...setting off on what I imagine will be a rather anticlimactic journey.
lines.zh: Karin 和 Miku 从地上爬起来，抓起书包放进女生更衣室，再出来……踏上了一段我想象中相当虎头蛇尾的旅程。

lines.en: Of course, Miku takes the lead and leaves both Karin and myself lingering in the background, equal parts confused and curious.
lines.zh: 当然，Miku 一马当先，把我和 Karin 都甩在后面慢慢跟着，一半困惑一半好奇。

lines.en: And, without any further delay, things become more or less as exhausting as I expected them to be as soon as the word “adventure” was broken out.
lines.zh: 而毫不意外地，从“冒险”这个词被说出口的那一刻起，事情就变得跟我预料中一样累人。

lines.en: scene karinadventure15
: There! At the end of this hall lies our final destination!
lines.zh: : 看那儿！这条走廊的尽头就是我们的最终目的地！

lines.en: : Um...actually...my room is on the second floor...
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实……我的教室在二楼……

lines.en: : Right! You’re so stacked that I often forget you’re a second year!
lines.zh: : 对哦！你身材好到让我经常忘了你是二年级！

lines.en: : Can you really say you didn’t expect things to turn out like this?
lines.zh: : 你真的能说自己没料到会变成这样吗？

lines.en: scene karinadventure16
: Well it’s not like I had a choice, is it?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我这不是没得选吗？

lines.en: : You literally gave up and let Miku vote for you. The three of us could be in the locker room together right now if you and I out-voted her.
lines.zh: : 你根本就是直接放弃，让 Miku 替你投了票。要是你和我联手压过她，我们三个现在就能一起待在更衣室里了。

lines.en: : I think you mean the gym, Sensei. You're not allowed in the locker room.
lines.zh: : 我想你说的是体育馆吧，Sensei。更衣室你可进不去。

lines.en: : I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我说了就是我说了。

lines.en: : You guys...I can only hold this pose for so long.
lines.zh: : 你们两个……这个姿势我撑不了太久。

lines.en: : If we’re gonna get past the dreaded six headed janitor demon, we’re gonna need to be real tactical with our movements and whatnot!
lines.zh: : 我们要想绕过那个可怕的六头看门恶魔，动作就必须相当有策略才行！

lines.en: : Then, once we find the destination...treasure will await!
lines.zh: : 然后，等我们找到了目的地……宝藏就在等着我们！

lines.en: scene karinadventure17
: There isn’t any treasure...I just need to grab my history textbook so I can study for a test.
lines.zh: : 没有什么宝藏……我只是要去拿我的历史课本，好复习考试。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes....tests.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊……考试。

lines.en: : I remember the days when {i}I{/i} was forced to learn!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}还记得那些被迫学习的日子！

lines.en: : Now, I’m free to wander the halls and the world to my heart’s content with my trusty companions...Karli and...Steve!
lines.zh: : 而现在，我可以和我可靠的伙伴们随心所欲地徜徉在走廊和整个世界之间……Karli 还有……Steve！

lines.en: scene karinadventure18
: Your real name is Steve?
lines.zh: : 你的真名是 Steve？

lines.en: : Yes. It’s nice to meet you, Karli.
lines.zh: : 是的。很高兴认识你，Karli。

lines.en: : You don’t look like a Steve.
lines.zh: : 你看起来不像 Steve。

lines.en: : Karin, come on. You’re smarter than this.
lines.zh: : Karin，拜托。你比这聪明多了。

lines.en: : I...am...losing...my...patience!
lines.zh: : 我……要……失去……耐心了！

lines.en: scene karinadventure19
: Let’s go, Steve.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Steve。

lines.en: : I’m sure it won’t be a very exciting adventure...but I guess we can have fun just...watching Miku have fun.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这不会是什么精彩的冒险……不过我想，光是看着 Miku 开心，我们也能开心起来。

lines.en: : I still think we should have had fun in the locker room instead.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得我们该在更衣室里找乐子才对。

lines.en: : Gym, Steve.
lines.zh: : 是体育馆，Steve。

lines.en: : It’s called a gym.
lines.zh: : 那叫体育馆。

lines.en: scene black
Karin and I walk slowly behind Miku as she marches down the halls of the[school].
lines.zh: Miku 在 [school] 的走廊里大步前进，我和 Karin 慢慢跟在她后面。

lines.en: The sound of her footsteps bounces off of the walls as she makes her presence known to virtually every person still inside of the building.
lines.zh: 她的脚步声在墙壁间回荡，几乎让这栋楼里还剩下的每一个人都察觉到了她的存在。

lines.en: I’m not a fan of the idea of being spotted with these two outside of normal[school] hours, but I guess I could always fall back on the fact that I’m just their coach or whatever.
lines.zh: 我不太想在正常 [school] 时间之外被人看见和她们俩在一起，不过我想我总还能拿“我不过是她们的教练”这种说法来搪塞。

lines.en: Unless there was supposed to be some sort of formal process for me to actually {i}accept{/i} and {i}assume{/i} that position.
lines.zh: 除非我其实该走某种正式流程，才能真正{i}接受{/i}并{i}担任{/i}这个职位。

lines.en: Now that I think of it, there probably was.
lines.zh: 现在想想，大概确实有。

lines.en: So, if we {i}are{/i} caught, I guess I’ll just have to, once again, take up the role of “mildly weird guy hanging out with girls who are way too [young]for him.”
lines.zh: 所以，要是{i}被抓到{/i}，我想我只好再一次扮演那个“跟比他小太多的女孩子混在一起、有点古怪的家伙”了。

lines.en: But hey, at least one of those two is responsible.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，至少她们两个里有一个是靠谱的。

lines.en: And the other one needs to sleep strapped into her bed so she doesn’t wind up dry humping older men in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 而另一个得被绑在床上睡，免得半夜三更爬起来隔着衣服蹭年长的男人。

lines.en: : Ahoy, mateys! Land ho!
lines.zh: : 哟吼，伙计们！看见陆地啦！

lines.en: : Are we pirates now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是海盗了吗？

lines.en: : A...Argh!
lines.zh: : 啊……啊嗬！

lines.en: : Karin, come on.
lines.zh: : Karin，拜托。

lines.en: : What?...I want to play along too...
lines.zh: : 怎么嘛……我也想一起玩……

lines.en: scene karinadventure20
Karin looks out of the window as she removes a textbook from the depths of her desk.
lines.zh: Karin 望着窗外，从书桌深处抽出了一本课本。

lines.en: Her tanned skin catches and absorbs the sunlight, distributing a fair amount of Vitamin D3 throughout her toned and divinely shaped body.
lines.zh: 她晒黑的皮肤捕捉并吸收着阳光，把相当可观的维生素 D3 输送到那具紧致而神圣的身躯里。

lines.en: I think about how many of the nutrients must have been intercepted by the glass and then attempt to wrap my mind around how light can carry value in the first place.
lines.zh: 我琢磨着这些营养有多少被玻璃拦了下来，然后又试图去理解：光这种东西，到底凭什么能承载价值。

lines.en: The only value I’ve ever assigned to things like that is the importance of its existence in terms of brightening up dark areas.
lines.zh: 我给这类东西赋予过的唯一价值，就是它存在本身对照亮黑暗之处的重要性。

lines.en: But when the world itself is overcome with darkness, no amount of sunlight or Vitamin D3 can truly return it to form.
lines.zh: 可是当这个世界本身被黑暗吞噬时，再多的阳光、再多的维生素 D3，也真的无法让它恢复原样。

lines.en: : Adventure complete!
lines.zh: : 冒险完成！

lines.en: : It wasn’t a {i}long{/i} journey, but it was a journey nonetheless!
lines.zh: : 虽然旅程不{i}长{/i}，但它终究是一段旅程！

lines.en: : Now, for our next adventure, I’d like to propose-
lines.zh: : 那么，关于我们的下一次冒险，我想提议——

lines.en: : Hm?
: Your phone?
lines.zh: : 你手机？

lines.en: : Guuuuuh. Yeah. Looks like Makoto needs to check on somethin’.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃。是啊。看来 Makoto 有事要我去确认一下。

lines.en: : Sensei! Keep an eye on Karin and make sure she doesn’t go...learning! Or doing other[school] stuff!
lines.zh: : Sensei！帮我看着 Karin，别让她……去学习！或者干别的 [school] 相关的事！

lines.en: : Just...do what you do best, I guess, and I’ll be right back!
lines.zh: : 就……做你最擅长的事吧，我马上回来！

lines.en: Miku leaves the room and suddenly the two people who didn’t even want to be a part of this adventure are the only ones left in the party.
lines.zh: Miku 离开了教室，于是这场冒险里唯一剩下的两个人，恰恰是当初根本不想参与的那两个。

lines.en: It’s not too nerdy for me to say that, is it? Party?
lines.zh: 我说“队伍”这个词，会不会太宅了？队伍？

lines.en: Who came up with that word anyway?
lines.zh: 这词到底是谁发明的？

lines.en: How much Vitamin D3 can bleed through glass?
lines.zh: 到底有多少维生素 D3 能透过玻璃渗进来？

lines.en: : I like the second floor, you know.
lines.zh: : 我挺喜欢二楼的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene karinadventure21
: S...Sorry...That probably sounded a little weird without any context, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 对……对不起……没有前因后果的话，这话听起来大概有点怪吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I’m not really one to judge peoples’ hobbies or interests...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我也不是那种会去评判别人爱好或兴趣的人……

lines.en: scene karinadventure22
: What I mean is that I kind of...like being in the middle of things.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，我有点……喜欢待在中间。

lines.en: : Being at the bottom sucks because you have so many stairs to walk up if you ever want to go to the roof or something like that-
lines.zh: : 待在最底层很糟，因为你要是哪天想去天台什么的，就得爬那么多层楼梯——

lines.en: : Granted, walking up stairs is an excellent form of cardio and-
lines.zh: : 当然了，爬楼梯是一种非常好的有氧运动，而且——

lines.en: : Finish your analogy before talking about exercise, please.
lines.zh: : 请把你的比喻说完，再谈运动。

lines.en: scene karinadventure21
: Heheh...whoops...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……哎呀……

lines.en: scene karinadventure20
: So, continuing from where I was...being at the top is also kind of frustrating because the only place to go from there is down.
lines.zh: : 那么，接着刚才说……待在顶层也有点让人沮丧，因为从那儿出发，唯一能去的地方就是往下。

lines.en: : When you’re in the middle, it’s like everyone is going to be forced to see you at some point. And you’re always only one step away from wherever you want to be.
lines.zh: : 而你在中间的时候，就好像大家迟早都得看见你。而且不管你想去哪儿，永远只有一步之遥。

lines.en: : I guess that wouldn’t really matter in a[school] with more than three floors, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是 [school] 超过三层，这一点大概就不太成立了。

lines.en: : If you’re trying to get some sort of point across, I’d appreciate a more direct approach.
lines.zh: : 如果你想表达什么观点，我希望你能直接一点。

lines.en: : Stairs are great and all-
lines.zh: : 楼梯确实很棒——

lines.en: : And excellent for cardio.
lines.zh: : 而且对有氧运动特别好。

lines.en: : Yes. And that.
lines.zh: : 对。还有这个。

lines.en: : But even though I’m in a classroom right now, I’d prefer to keep my “teaching hat” off.
lines.zh: : 不过虽然我现在人在教室里，我还是更想摘下我的“教师帽”。

lines.en: scene karinadventure23
: Can I...tell you one of the reasons I like you as a coach, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我能……告诉你我为什么喜欢你当教练吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Does it have something to do with stairs?
lines.zh: : 跟楼梯有关吗？

lines.en: : A little bit. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点。是的。

lines.en: : But...one of the reasons I like you as a coach, even though you barely do any {i}coaching{/i}...is that you don’t really expect any more out of me than you do anyone else.
lines.zh: : 不过……我喜欢你当教练的原因之一——尽管你基本没怎么{i}执教{/i}——是你对我的期望，并没有比对别人更高。

lines.en: : It’s kind of refreshing in a way.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，这挺让人舒心的。

lines.en: : Like I can hang out on the second floor for as long as I want and you’ll just walk past me and not be like, “Karin! Someone upstairs needs you!”
lines.zh: : 就像我可以在二楼想待多久就待多久，而你就这么从我身边走过去，不会说“Karin！楼上有人需要你！”

lines.en: : Are you exhausted?
lines.zh: : 你累了吗？

lines.en: scene karinadventure24
: From practice or in general?
lines.zh: : 是训练累，还是总的来说？

lines.en: : From all of the people trying to make you change floors.
lines.zh: : 是那些想让你换楼层的人累。

lines.en: scene karinadventure25
: Kinda.
lines.zh: : 有点。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: And I can’t even complain about it because then it will just sound like I’m stepping on the toes of everyone who wishes they were as...tall or...muscular or-
lines.zh: : 而且我连抱怨都没法抱怨，因为那样听起来，就像我是在踩那些希望自己能像我一样……高、或者……壮、或者——的人的痛脚。

lines.en: : Talented?
lines.zh: : 有才华？

lines.en: scene karinadventure26
: Sorry. I’m just being dramatic, I think.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想我只是在小题大做。

lines.en: : It’s not like I planned on talking about this today or anything.
lines.zh: : 我今天本来也没打算说这些。

lines.en: scene karinadventure27
: Just...thinking out loud as I look outside the window.
lines.zh: : 只是……看着窗外，把心里想的说出来罢了。

lines.en: : Wishing I could trade places with someone like Kirin for a day or two...and not being able to talk to {i}her{/i} about it because she’ll just get mad.
lines.zh: : 希望自己能和 Kirin 那样的人交换一两天人生……却又没法跟{i}她{/i}说，因为她只会生气。

lines.en: : Yeah, it would probably be best if you never repeated that to her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话你最好永远别在她面前再说一遍。

lines.en: : Which is part of the problem.
lines.zh: : 而这正是问题的一部分。

lines.en: : Her and my parents...they all think I’m some sort of...amazing human being. The rest of the girls on the soccer team do too.
lines.zh: : 她和我爸妈……他们都觉得我是某种……了不起的人。足球队的其他女生也这么想。

lines.en: : Like, Miku is better than me in pretty much every way, but still {i}I’m{/i} the one people are looking up to most of the time.
lines.zh: : 比如说，Miku 几乎在各方面都比我强，可大多数时候，被大家仰望的{i}还是我{/i}。

lines.en: : To be fair, it’s probably pretty difficult to look {i}up{/i} to Miku.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，要{i}仰望{/i} Miku 大概确实挺难的。

lines.en: scene karinadventure28
: I was hoping that joke wasn’t coming.
lines.zh: : 我还指望你不会讲这个笑话呢。

lines.en: : I couldn’t resist and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我忍不住，抱歉。

lines.en: : But hey, on the bright side, you’re still {i}technically{/i} on the second floor from at least an academic standpoint.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，往好处想，至少从学业的角度来说，你{i}确实{/i}还在二楼。

lines.en: : True. But even that has its downsides.
lines.zh: : 没错。但就连这个也有坏处。

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: : Like...
lines.zh: : 比如……

lines.en: scene karinadventure29
: L...Like I...can’t be in your class, for example...
lines.zh: : 比……比如我……不能分在你的班上……

lines.en: : You’re the first b...boy I’ve ever been able to talk to without exploding...
lines.zh: : 你是第一个我……我能好好说话而不炸掉的男生……

lines.en: : So if I got to see you every day, maybe I’d get better at facing one of my many, many fears?
lines.zh: : 所以如果每天都能见到你，说不定我就能更擅长去面对我那许许多多恐惧中的一个？

lines.en: : Many?
lines.zh: : 许许多多？

lines.en: : How many fears can someone like you have?
lines.zh: : 像你这样的人能有多少恐惧啊？

lines.en: scene karinadventure30
: Let’s see...
lines.zh: : 让我想想……

lines.en: : So there’s snakes...
lines.zh: : 首先是蛇……

lines.en: : And heights...and large fish...
lines.zh: : 还有高处……还有大鱼……

lines.en: : And that sound macaroni and cheese makes when you stir it.
lines.zh: : 还有搅芝士通心粉时发出的那种声音。

lines.en: : And graveyards and gondola rides.
lines.zh: : 还有墓地，还有坐贡多拉。

lines.en: : And those weird dream loops you get where one dream ends only to throw you into the middle of another one-
lines.zh: : 还有那种奇怪的梦境循环——一个梦刚结束，就把你丢进另一个梦的中间——

lines.en: : And then the next thing you know, you have to change a tire for Serena Williams on the way to Newark, New Jersey.
lines.zh: : 然后一转眼，你就得在去新泽西州纽瓦克的路上给 Serena Williams 换轮胎了。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene karinadventure31
: I’m scared of a lot of weird stuff, okay?! It’s not my fault!
lines.zh: : 我害怕的东西就是又多又怪，行了吧？！这又不是我的错！

lines.en: scene karinadventure32
: I’m a little less scared...whenever you’re around...
lines.zh: : 只要你在身边……我就没那么害怕了……

lines.en: : Okaaaaaay! Miku’s back, y’all! Which means-
lines.zh: : 好——啦！Miku 回来了，各位！也就是说——

lines.en: : Hey, what are you two doin’ just standin’ around in silence?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们两个干吗一声不吭地站着？

lines.en: : I know I’m the leader of the adventure squad, but if we’re ever gonna find {i}real{/i} treasure, we’re gonna have to bump up the team chemistry!
lines.zh: : 我知道我是冒险小队的队长，但我们要想找到{i}真正{/i}的宝藏，就得提升一下队伍的默契！

lines.en: : So go ahead and hug it out so we can get a move on!
lines.zh: : 所以你们先抱一个，我们好继续出发！

lines.en: scene karinadventure33
: I-I-I-I can’t hug Sensei! We’re not married yet!
lines.zh: : 我我我我不能抱 Sensei！我们还没结婚呢！

lines.en: : Yet?
lines.zh: : 还没？

lines.en: : You know what I mean!
lines.zh: : 你知道我什么意思！
: 我知道吗？……

lines.en: : Blah blah fear of boys blah blah.
lines.zh: : 巴拉巴拉怕男生巴拉巴拉。

lines.en: : You’d think somebody as tall and muscular and talented as you wouldn’t have any trouble at all with somethin’ like that, Kari-
lines.zh: : 你会觉得，像你这么高、这么壮、这么有才华的人，对这种事应该一点问题都没有才对，Kari——

lines.en: : Err, I mean...Karli!
lines.zh: : 呃，我是说……Karli！

lines.en: scene karinadventure34
: Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You...{i}would{/i} think that...wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}会{/i}这么想……对吧？

lines.en: scene black
We have three more adventures before the morning comes to an end.
lines.zh: 在这个上午结束前，我们还有三次冒险。

lines.en: All of them take place on the second floor of the[school] building.
lines.zh: 全都在 [school] 楼的二层进行。

$ karinsoccer20 = True
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}
